item.title: Leveraging Packaging Technology and Design for a Safer Food Supply
item.description: A food manufacturer’s packaging line represents both the last opportunity to protect food and the last place where risk can be introduced. Treating the packaging line as a critical control point is essential to moving from reactive compliance to proactive prevention.

item.title: VIDEO | Food Plant Openings and Expansions January 2026
item.description: EIC Alyse Thompson-Richards recaps some recent plant openings and expansions in the food and beverage industry, including DrinkPAK’s East Coast beverage manufacturing facility, V&V Supremo’s Wisconsin plant, Danone’s Texas facility expansion, Cal-Maine Foods’ optimization and expansion project, and MMPA’s dairy plant acquisition.

item.title: Puratos Partners with California Cultured to Commercialize Cultured Cocoa
item.description: Together, the two companies aim to commercialize a cultured chocolate product for professionals and food brands.

item.title: Mars to Purchase Renewable Energy from Swedish Wind Farm
item.description: Through a long-term agreement, Mars has secured 70% of the annual production from the Kölvallen Wind Farm.

item.title: ESI Group Introduces Strategic Growth Team
item.description: ESI Group’s Strategic Growth Team unites business development, marketing and preconstruction experts into a collaborative unit.

item.title: Hormel Foods Names Donald Monk as First CTO
item.description: Monk brings more than 35 years of global technology leadership to Hormel Foods, including 33 years at General Mills, where he ultimately served as chief information officer.

item.title: ISA Publishes New Standard for SCADA Systems
item.description: The ISA-112 Part 1 standard provides a vendor-neutral and technology-independent framework for the long-term management of SCADA systems and execution of SCADA modernization projects.

item.title: Litehouse Inc. Rebrands as Litehouse Foods
item.description: The company has unveiled a refreshed vision and values that brings its full portfolio of brands together, including Litehouse, Organicville, Veggiecraft, Sky Valley and partnered licensed brands including Flavortown, and Zaxbys.

item.title: Nulogy Debuts Manufacturing Operating System
item.description: With Nulogy MOS, manufacturers, contract packagers and 3PLs can manage production, quality, compliance and collaboration within one system.

item.title: Daikin Introduces R-290 Industrial Heat Pumps Up to 2,000 KW
item.description: The new platform is structured into two complementary ranges: EWA/YK-CZ monobloc units, from 20 to 85 kW, and EWYK-QZ modular heat pumps, configurable in multi-array systems up to 2,000 kW.
